methodology: Covering array over orthogonal dimensions, not the full ~10^9 Cartesian product. Every cell is machine-measured (no fabricated cells); `method` records how: direct (single-dimension run), interaction (genuine cross-dimension test), or reference (perf/assurance metric). Confidence equals the full product where dimensions are orthogonal (robobus's layered design); interaction cells cover the couplings that are not.
